sentences.text: Ghulam Rasool Hajam vs Piyush Singla And Ors on 9 August,

2023 
Author: Sanjay Dhar
Bench: Sanjay Dhar
 S. No. 08
 Regular matter
High Court Of Jammu &Kashmir And Ladakh

Petitioner(s)
 Through: Mr. Rizwan ul Zaman, Adv.
 V/s
Piyush Singla and Ors. ..... Respondent(s)

Through: Mr. Satinder Singh Kala, Aag
 with Ms. Raheela Khan, Adv.

Coram:
 Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar, Judge.

Statement of facts filed by respondent No. 2 indicates that the land measuring 13.5 Marlas is presently occupied by Industrial Estate, Jablipora, Bijbehara out of which, the compensation for land measuring 7 marlas has already been received by the petitioner, meaning thereby that the petitioner has not received the compensation for balance land measuring 5 marlas.

The statement of facts further indicates that General Manager, DIC Anantnag has been asked to place a formal indent under the new law relating to land acquisition viz, The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement, Act 2013 for acquisition of balance land measuring 6.5 Marlas.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement, Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, the matter has not been finalized as yet.
The statement of facts also indicates that an amount of Rs. 15.00 lacs stands deposited Page |2 by the indenting department with the Collector land Acquisition, Bijbehara 2.

From the above, it is clear that even as per the stand of the respondents, the petitioner has not been paid compensation for land measuring 6.5 marlas nor has compensation been assessed in respect of the aforesaid land.

As per the direction of the writ Court, the respondents were asked to work out and assess the compensation and pay the same to the petitioner on account of acquisition of his proprietary land Ghulam Rasool Hajam vs Piyush Singla And Ors on 9 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92086640/
1 3.

entities.text: Ghulam Rasool Hajam vs Piyush Singla And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of above, the respondents are directed to take all necessary steps for assessing and releasing the compensation in favour of the petitioner in respect of the whole of the occupied land in accordance with law expeditiously and file fresh compliance report by next date of hearing.

(Sanjay Dhar) Judge SRINAGAR 09.08.2023 "Aasif"
